structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a late copy of the 'Effective Accelerationism' (e/acc) ticker. It appears to be one of a burst of about 10 same-name tokens launched within roughly 50 minutes, apparently set off by a Beff Jezos X post (the GeckoTerminal twitter field points to beffjezos/status/...). The token launched directly on a Meteora pool, not on pump.fun. It is about 10 minutes old and up about 1000% to roughly $125k market cap. It has traded $1.26M in volume and shows 1,569 unique buyers against only 78 unique sellers. The dev seeded the liquidity and 100% of it is unlocked. GMGN flags 74 bundler wallets, and bundlers account for about 67% of top-trader activity.

narrative.description: e/acc, a well-known tech/AI meme tied to Beff Jezos (Guillaume Verdon). The trigger seems to be a real post from a prominent account, and it has produced many copycat tokens.
narrative.why_spreading: Tokens fire off a well-known figure's tweet. The theme is broad and recognizable, and bots and snipers mass-deploy copies of the ticker within minutes.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its only link is the same name and ticker. It is not the earliest copy and not the leader. It was launched about 45 minutes after the first e/acc copy in this wave.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 same-ticker tokens from the same hour. Leaders are CbcyNo7m ($1.1M mcap, earliest), 3m7Bhp7G ($873k), DseCuJgA ($556k), 7dVWLAdH ($362k, $8.7M h1 volume) and 13vVSQAL ($267k liquidity). There is also an older 2024 pump.fun e/acc.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 74 bundler wallets with a top_bundler_trader_pct of 0.67 and a bot/degen rate of 0.38. Unique buyers outnumber unique sellers about 20 to 1 (1,569 vs 78) while buy and sell transaction counts run only about 1.8 to 1, which suggests a few wallets are doing all the selling in large amounts. Volume is about 10x market cap in 10 minutes. The launch was a direct Meteora pool with unlocked LP, no socials and no profile.
authenticity.uncertainty: Copies of a real viral tweet can draw real retail buyers, and without X data I can't measure how much organic spillover this copy is getting.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked on a dev-seeded Meteora pool, so the creator can remove liquidity at any time
It is a late copy competing with about 9 same-ticker tokens, several of them 5-9x larger
No website, socials or DexScreener profile
GeckoTerminal puts the top 10 holders at 72%, possibly including the pool, while RugCheck puts them at 21.6%

structured_output.counterargument: Beff Jezos is a big account, and the tweet may be early in its spread. As buyers from the tweet rotate across copies, a $125k copy with $72k of liquidity could catch overflow from the leaders and double quickly; volume and buyer counts are very large for its size. Mint and freeze authority are renounced, and the top-10 holder share is modest on RugCheck.
unknowns: Whether the dev pulls the unlocked LP
Whether any same-ticker copy is endorsed or becomes the accepted main token
Exact content and reach of the Beff Jezos post
How much of the buyer count is bundler or bot wallets

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition; judged from the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This is a late, bundled, unlocked-LP Meteora copy in a crowded field of same-ticker tokens set off by one tweet. Attention will likely go to the earlier and larger copies. The dev-controlled liquidity makes a pull or slow bleed more likely than a 2x from a $125k entry after the token is already up 10x.
